applyTo: "{src/**/*.php,views/**/*.php,resources/languages/**/*.ini,assets/src/**/*.{ts,vue}}"

# i18n / Locale Instructions

Rules for adding or changing translatable text in `windwalker/unicorn`. Public
reference: <https://windwalker.io/documentation/components/language/index.md>
(plus `translation.md`, `loading.md`, `plurals.md`, `debugging.md`).

> **MANDATORY — read first.** Before adding, renaming, or reusing ANY
> translation key, you MUST read
> [`../docs/locale-key-naming.md`](../docs/locale-key-naming.md). It defines the
> standard key naming strategy (scopes, purpose sections, shared `field.*`
> terms, derived keys, meaning-based naming). Keys that ignore it must not be
> committed. The "Key naming" section below is only a short summary.

## How translation works (summary)

1. **Language files** live in `resources/languages/<locale>/<name>.ini`. This
   package ships `en-US` (fallback) and `zh-TW`, both in `unicorn.ini`.
2. **Loading**: Windwalker Core's `LangService` (wraps
   `Windwalker\Language\Language`) loads files per locale. `loadAll()` /
   `loadFile()` read the `language.paths` config (default `@languages`);
   `loadAllFromVendor()` reads `@vendor/<package>/resources/languages`.
   The fallback locale loads first, then the current locale overrides it. In
   debug mode (`LANG_DEBUG` + app debug) the fallback is *not* merged into other
   locales, so missing keys show as `??key??`.
3. **Install**: `UnicornPackage` calls
   `$installer->installLanguages(.../resources/languages/**/*, 'lang')`, so the
   files can be copied into the host app's `resources/languages` with the
   `lang` tag. Host copies may be edited by the host; package defaults stay here.
4. **Lookup**: keys are normalized (any char outside `A-Za-z0-9` becomes `.`,
   lowercased), so `unicorn.field_name` and `unicorn.field.name` collide. Order:
   current locale → fallback locale → parent (`extract()`). A missing key
   returns the key itself.
5. **Frontend** gets strings only if the backend exports them (see below).

## Key naming

- Every key in this package starts with `unicorn.` and uses lowercase dot
  segments, e.g. `unicorn.field.modal.max.selected`,
  `unicorn.message.batch.rebuild.success`.
- Group by area: `unicorn.core.*`, `unicorn.field.*`, `unicorn.message.*`,
  `unicorn.title.*`, `unicorn.state.*`, `unicorn.batch.*`.
- Never use `_`, `-` or camelCase to distinguish keys; they normalize to the
  same key.
- Do not build keys from user input. Dynamic suffixes are allowed only from
  closed sets (e.g. enum keys: `'unicorn.state.' . $this->getKey()`); every
  possible value must have a key.

## Language files (`.ini`)

- Add every new key to **both** `en-US/unicorn.ini` and `zh-TW/unicorn.ini`
  (the two files must keep identical key sets; currently 173 each).
- One `key="value"` per line, value always double-quoted, UTF-8, no section
  headers. HTML inside values is allowed (`<strong>`) but must be intentional
  because output may not be escaped.
- Escape a literal `"` inside a value as `\"`. Escape literal `%` as `%%` when the
  string is called with positional args.
- Placeholders: use named `:name` (replaced by `trans('k', name: $v)`; `:NAME`
  uppercases, `:Name` capitalizes first letter) or positional `%s` / `%d`
  (`trans('k', $a, $b)`). Pick one style per string. Keep the same placeholders
  in every locale. Existing keys mostly use `%s`; `unicorn.title.*` uses `:title`.
- Keep keys alphabetically grouped with their neighbours; do not reorder
  existing lines unnecessarily.
- Traditional Chinese (`zh-TW`) uses full-width punctuation and Taiwan
  terminology.
- Do not delete or rename a key that may be used by host apps without
  checking usages (`src/`, `views/`, `assets/src/`) and treating it as a
  breaking change.

## Backend (PHP)

- In container-created classes use `Windwalker\Core\Language\TranslatorTrait`
  (`$this->trans()`, `$this->choice()`), or inject `LangService`. Never
  `new LangService`/`new Language`. Enums implementing
  `TranslatableInterface` receive a `LanguageInterface $lang`.
- **Named args must be passed by name**: `trans('k', name: $v)`. An array
  as second argument is treated as a positional value and does nothing.
- Plurals: `choice($id, $number, ...)` with plural rules; see `plurals.md`.
- Wrap text that must never be translated in `raw()` (`use function Windwalker\raw;`).
- Edge views: use `$lang(...)`/`$this->trans(...)` helpers already used in
  neighbouring templates; never hard-code user-visible English/Chinese.
- Generated code (`FormFieldsBuilder`) emits `$this->trans('<key>')` for labels;
  keep that contract.
- Use `LangService::has()` for optional keys instead of comparing the result to
  the key.

## Frontend (TypeScript / Vue)

The browser has no access to `.ini` files. The flow is:

1. PHP exports strings with `UnicornScript::translate()`:
   ```php
   $unicornScript->translate('unicorn.message.delete.confirm');
   $unicornScript->translate(['a.b', 'c.d']);
   $unicornScript->translate('unicorn.field.file.drag.*'); // prefix wildcard
   ```
   Keys are normalized and **translated server-side** in the current locale
   (fallback merged), then stored in the data bag `unicorn.languages`, which is
   output to the page and read by `assets/src/service/lang.ts`.
2. TypeScript reads them with `trans()` / `__()` (same function):
   ```ts
   import { __ } from '../service';
   __('unicorn.field.modal.max.selected', max);          // positional %s/%d (sprintf-js)
   __('unicorn.title.edit', { title: 'Foo' });           // named :title
   ```
   Object args replace `:key`; scalar args feed `vsprintf`. Missing keys return
   the original id (`??id??` in debug).

Rules:

- Every key used by `__()`/`trans()` in `assets/src/` must be exported by PHP
  in the code path that loads that module: the global ones in
  `UnicornScript::main()`, module-specific ones in the relevant script class
  (e.g. `FormScript` for `unicorn.field.sid.*`, `file.drag.*`,
  `multi.uploader.*`). Adding a frontend string means: ini keys (both
  locales) + `translate()` call + `__()` usage.
- Prefer a wildcard (`prefix.*`) when a module uses a family of keys; use
  explicit keys otherwise so the payload stays small.
- Do not call `__()` with a runtime-built key unless the whole family is
  exported by wildcard.
- Do not hard-code user-visible text in TS/Vue; use `__()`. Strings coming from
  the host app go through its own `translate()` call.
- Never put secrets or HTML-unsafe unescaped user data into language strings;
  they are serialized into the page.
- `assets/dist/` is built output; do not hand-edit.

## Verification

- Ensure language keys follow the naming rules in `locale-key-naming.md` and this file.
- Compare key sets of `en-US/unicorn.ini` and `zh-TW/unicorn.ini` after any
  language change; they must match.
- Search for usage before removing keys:
  `grep -r "unicorn.some.key" src views assets/src`.
- Manually check with `LANG_DEBUG=1`: `??key??` in the page means a missing key
  (PHP) or a missing `translate()` export (JS).
- Run `composer test` if PHP behavior changed.
